A T-cell engager (TCE) program owes around twenty dose and regimen decisions
between the first-in-human protocol and the label. They are made at different
times by different functions, and no single document holds the list, so a
decision taken as provisional in year one is found in year four to have
committed the program.

This project builds one landscape page that holds the list. For each decision:
where it stands, when it is due, what evidence will answer it, whether the team
agrees, and who decides. The page is revisited at each milestone rather than
written once.

The starting point is the dose and regimen framework Sander et al. published in
2021, which runs to two pages and is written for any drug. This narrows it to
one page and to the decisions a TCE actually faces, the step-up schedule first.

Nothing here has been used on a program, and the source paper has not been read
in full.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What the page holds, the seven
  columns and why each earns its width, the two status axes, the TCE decision
  inventory, the gates, and the departures from the initial notes with a
  reason for each. Its **In brief** section is one screen and says what the
  rest argues.
- [Specimen page](one-page-strategy.qmd). The artifact itself, filled in for an
  invented program, with the blank template underneath it to copy.
- [References](references.qmd). What to read and in what order, and a marker on
  every source recording whether the claim drawn from it has been checked.
  Every marker is currently ❌.

## Related projects here

- [TCE-CRS-tolerance](../tce-crs-tolerance/index.qmd) supplies the mechanism
  behind decisions A3 to A5, the size and spacing of the step-up doses.
- [Faster first-in-human TCE studies](../tce-ipde/index.qmd) supplies
  decisions A1 and B2, the starting dose and the escalation rule.
